content.title: Ford Teams Up With Amazon to Sell Certified Used Cars Online
content.description: Ford Motor Co. has struck a deal to sell certified used cars through Amazon.com Inc. Ford becomes the second automaker on the Amazon Autos portal, which allows car buyers to browse, finance and purchase a used car. Keith Naughton reports on Bloomberg Television.

content.title: Carvana and CarMax stock falls after Ford partners with Amazon
content.summary: Investing.com -- Carvana (NYSE:CVNA) stock fell 2.6% and CarMax (NYSE:KMX) stock dropped 1.7% on Monday after Ford Motor (NYSE:F) announced a partnership with Amazon (NASDAQ:AMZN) to sell certified used vehicles through the e-commerce giant’s platform.
